name: rust-learning-lab
description: Learn and review Rust through syntax, design rationale, code tracing, practice, and debugging.

interface.shortDescription: Learn Rust and review code with clear reasoning.
interface.longDescription: Explain Rust syntax and its purpose, trace types and ownership, and review code with concrete findings and understandable fixes. Build independent skills through practice and verification.
defaultPrompt: Explain this Rust code from syntax to purpose.
Review this Rust change and explain each finding.
Help me debug this Rust code and understand the fix.
